samples.summary: Notes view-preference state machine duplicated between the two mounting routes instead of reused
samples.evidence: `shared-notes-layout.tsx` reproduces `notes-detail.tsx`'s state trio (`viewMode`/`keymap`/`showAuthors` seeded from `readViewMode`/`readKeymap`/`readShowAuthors`) and the mobile demotion expression verbatim — `const effectiveViewMode: NoteViewMode = isMobile && viewMode === "both" ? "edit" : viewMode;` appears at `notes-detail.tsx:119-120` and `shared-notes-layout.tsx:66-67`, comment and all. No shared hook (e.g. `useNoteViewPreferences`) was extracted, even though the whole point of issue #1044 is that notes' two entry paths had drifted apart; the next change to the demotion rule can drift them again. The repo elsewhere expects reuse for exactly this kind of shared behaviour.

samples.summary: Canonical share-link design doc (`docs/design/sharing.md`) not updated for the notes share surface's new uploader, toolbar and read-only gates
samples.evidence: All of the new share-link behaviour is documented only in `docs/design/notes/notes.md` (§Share-link parity). `docs/design/sharing.md` is the canonical share doc and carries per-package read-only sections (`### Sheet Package (Read-Only Mode)` L151, `### Docs Package (Read-Only Mode)` L163) plus a §Security paragraph (L200-219) arguing the client `readOnly` flag is the effective write boundary while the Yorkie webhook is in shadow mode, citing `packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts`. The notes engine's new equivalent (EditorState.readOnly + `changeFilter` admitting only `Transaction.remote`, `runHistory` refusal) is nowhere in it, and L131 ("Slides, board and sheets share-link mounts still pass no uploader, so image insert stays unavailable there") plus L140-149 ("per-type read-only layout") were left as-is even though the notes mount now passes `shareTokenImageUploader(token)` and mounts a toolbar for viewers.

samples.summary: `notes-settings.ts` module doc now contradicts the change it is consumed by
samples.evidence: Header comment: "The owner editor (NotesDetail) reads them on open and writes them on change; the read-only shared viewer does not use them." As of this change `shared-notes-layout.tsx:8-11` imports `readKeymap`/`readShowAuthors`/`readViewMode` and the shared viewer does use them (read-only, never written). The diff updated the analogous comments in `notes-toolbar.tsx` and `notes-view.tsx` but missed this one.

samples.summary: Share-link image-upload failures are silent, unlike the workspace route the change claims parity with
samples.evidence: `notes-detail.tsx:208-231` wraps the uploader so a failure surfaces a `toast.error` and returns `null` — the contract `NotesViewProps.uploadImage` documents ("or `null` if the upload failed and was already reported to the user", notes-view.tsx:45-48). `shared-notes-layout.tsx` passes the raw `shareTokenImageUploader(token)`, which rejects on failure; `packages/notes/src/view/image-upload.ts:179-188` catches the rejection, logs to console and silently drops the placeholder. So on the share surface an upload failure gives the visitor no feedback at all, a user-visible divergence from the workspace path this change exists to bring to parity.
